decisions.reason: This premium raisin Christmas stollen is very close to our established confectionery know-how and its repeated gold-medal recognition in 2023 and 2024 gives us clear, credible feedback that we can use to keep commercialising and refining it.

This dark barley malt rye bread builds directly on our core bread expertise, and because it remained prominently offered through 2024 with no negative signal, we can reasonably interpret the early market experience as strong enough to continue and improve within existing capabilities.

This marzipan Christmas stollen is closely related to our existing seasonal pastry knowledge and production base, and its continued dedicated presentation through 2024 suggests sufficient demand to justify keeping it while learning incrementally from sales and customer response.
